name: premiere-editor-assistant
description: A local Premiere Pro workflow with usable Takes, complete Selects, guarded editing and OMF sound handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Build usable Takes and Selects in Premiere Pro
interface.longDescription: Prepare editable, script-aware Takes and Selects with proxy playback, main-voice transcription, shared part colors and verified edit recovery. Export OMF sound handoffs from separate audio-only copies. Local macOS workflow with guided Premiere bridge setup.
defaultPrompt: Set up Premiere Editor Assistant on this Mac.
Create Takes and Selects from my Premiere sequence and storyboard.
Export an OMF sound handoff from my Premiere sequence.
